name: Jeroen.nl - Onafhankelijk energieplatform
description:
Jeroen.nl is an independent Dutch energy platform. This connector gives Claude live energy data for the Netherlands, so answers about electricity prices, solar panels and energy contracts are based on current numbers instead of outdated knowledge. Free, no account or sign-in needed.

What you can ask about
- Day-ahead electricity prices per quarter hour or hour, with full history since 2013
- Daily gas prices since 2018
- Electricity price forecast for the coming days, with an uncertainty band
- Expected average electricity, feed-in and gas prices for the next 12 months
- Solar yield forecast for any location in the Netherlands, per kWp or for your own system, with a p10 to p90 band
- All Dutch dynamic energy suppliers with their fees and monthly costs, including VAT
- Solar bonuses of suppliers, and which one pays most per hour and panel orientation
- Grid operator costs per operator and connection size

Built-in guidance for contract advice
Ask which dynamic energy contract fits you, and Claude first asks a few short questions (solar panels, feed-in, usage, gas) before comparing suppliers including VAT, monthly costs and solar bonuses. The prompt "advies dynamisch contract" starts this directly.

Good to know
- Read-only: the connector only retrieves data and never changes anything.
- Works in Dutch and English, for example: "Wanneer is de stroomprijs morgen het laagst?"
- Supplier links go through jeroen.nl for routing and click statistics. Jeroen.nl may receive a fee from some suppliers; this never affects order or comparisons.
- Want Claude to use your own jeroen.nl data as well (power analyses, smart meter data, solar panels, home battery)? Add https://jeroen.nl/mcp/account as a custom connector and sign in with a free jeroen.nl account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jeroen.nl - Onafhankelijk energieplatform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jeroen.nl - Onafhankelijk energieplatform to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://jeroen.nl/mcp.
